decisions.reason: Its dedicated page signals continued commitment, and with only one year of results under uncertainty, organizational slack allows keeping it while management assesses performance against aspirations.

As a generic in a competitive, price-sensitive segment, its results may fall below aspirations and trigger problemistic search, but organizational slack and the dedicated page support carrying it for another year.

Combination antihypertensives address a large therapeutic area and the dedicated page indicates strategic support, so despite uncertain first-year results, slack supports keeping it to see if aspirations are met.

Being only mentioned on the website suggests low strategic priority and likely below-aspiration performance for a non-core supplement, so problemistic search favors releasing its resources to established business or new development projects.
